context:
Decision gate: owner only; agents never answer, infer or mark these confirmed. Until answered, the provisional values stay in force as written in the ADR and on the site methodology page.

Item guardrails: no agent edits to the ADR, methodology page or CLI behaviour under this item; amendments go through new items.

Verification rubric: pass = every line answered by the owner in this item's context. Fail = any answer recorded by an agent.

Origin: collected 2026-11-17 from the policy-docs (PR #4272, site #166) and CLI hygiene (PR #4276) deliveries.

Owner decision 2026-11-17: Methodology answers confirmed, except hardware: full ranking facet (rank only within the same CPU model and core count). EULA 4c(3): current 'Derived from' wording accepted. Citation format: 'BenchBox <version>, result <public_result_id>, <permalink>, accessed <date>. Not an official TPC result.' CLI: --non-interactive counts for the driver auto-install gate (confirmed); package-smoke runs on any benchbox/** change (confirmed); orphan-spin report at >=50% CPU for 300 s (confirmed). Amendments filed as methodology-finalize-hardware-facet-and-citation-20261117.
description:
Agents made these provisional so work could land; each stands until the owner amends it.
Methodology (ADR docs/internal/adr/adr-benchmark-methodology-provisional-policy.md, site methodology page): 1 warm-up plus at least 3 measured iterations; median with min/max spread; noise floor 1.25 x largest spread over 5 same-class runs; published results are warm-state only; hardware is not a ranking facet; regression threshold 10% plus floor. Open with no answer: whether the 'Derived from' wording satisfies EULA clause 4c(3), and the citation format for third parties.
CLI (PR #4276): --non-interactive counts as non-interactive for the driver auto-install gate; package-smoke runs on any benchbox/** change; orphan-spin report thresholds 50% CPU for 300 s.

Outcome: each line is confirmed or amended by the owner, and amendments are filed as items.
